app_store.name: savideo: Clean Video Saver
app_store.subtitle: One link, one file, no ads
app_store.promotional_text: Paste a link to your own video and keep a copy on your phone. No ads, no pop-ups, no account. Trim before you save.
app_store.description:
savideo saves a copy of a video from its link. Nothing else gets in the way.

No ads. No pop-ups. No account. No fake virus warnings.

How it works:
1. Copy the link to a video you own or have permission to save.
2. Paste it into savideo.
3. Pick a quality, trim if you like, and save it to Files or Photos.

What you get:
- Every quality the source has, up to 4K
- Trim: save just the part you need
- Sound only, as an audio file
- Clear errors that say why a link didn't work and what to do next
- Recent saves kept only on this device

We don't store your files on our servers and we don't sell data.

Only save videos you own or have the right to save. Respect each creator's rights and each site's rules.
